title: Calgary SPV-004 Ventilation for Acceptable Indoor Air Quality

facts.text: SPV-004 is dated February 25, 2020 and names NBC(AE) 2019 Division B Sentence 1.3.1.2(1), and Article 6.2.1.1 on good engineering practice.
The subject is ANSI/ASHRAE 62-2001, except addendum n; the variance permits more recent versions of that referenced standard under its stated criteria.

The Engineer of Record must review, sign and seal mechanical drawings; identify in writing the proposed ASHRAE 62 version and state ventilation rates are sufficient for intended occupancy; and state the selected standard will be used in full for the entire project scope.
The document requires SPV-004 references in permit documents and permit conditions, and says it applies to the building-permit address.
Calgary's 2025 ventilation advisory addresses smoking rooms under NBC(AE) 2023 and identifies a different standard version and specific scope; it is not the text of SPV-004.

limitations: The City current standing-variance table does not list SPV-004, although its official direct URL remains downloadable.
Current posting and applicability are not established; the Calgary page says posted documents may be removed.
B23-011 is a separate 2025 advisory and has a different stated scope; it is context, not an update to SPV-004.
This is an issued reference, not an individual application or professional mechanical design.
